options.title: Kea Option
options.description:
A raw Kea option-data entry, for options the other fields do not cover.

Required fields are:
  * `name`

Optional fields are:
  * `data`
  * `value`
  * `code`
  * `space`
  * `csv-format`
  * `always-send`

name.title: Option Name
name.description: Kea option name, for example `domain-search` or `interface-mtu`.

data.title: Option Data
data.description: Option value as Kea expects it (comma-separated for lists). `value` is accepted as an alias.

code.title: Option Code
code.description: Option code, required for custom options.

space.title: Option Space
space.description: Option space. The default value is `dhcp4`.

csv-format.title: CSV Format
csv-format.description: Whether `data` is comma-separated text (true) or hex (false).

always-send.title: Always Send
always-send.description: Send the option even when the client did not request it.

reservations.title: DHCP Reservation
reservations.description:
A fixed address for one device MAC address. The Automation UI builds these from the Initial Inventory.

Required fields are:
  * `mac`
  * `ip`

Optional fields are:
  * `hostname`
  * `subnet`
  * `routers`
  * `domain_name_servers`
  * `tftp_server`
  * `bootfile`
  * `options`

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: Reserved address; must fall inside the subnet.

subnet.title: Subnet
subnet.description: Name of the subnet that owns the reservation. Defaults to the subnet that contains `ip`.

options.title: Host Options
options.description: Extra Kea option-data entries for this host.

subnets.title: DHCP Subnet
subnets.description:
A subnet served by Kea. Bootstrap subnets usually only hand out reservations.

Required fields are:
  * `name`
  * `network`
  * `netmask`

Optional fields are:
  * `routers`
  * `domain_name`
  * `domain_name_servers`
  * `ntp_servers`
  * `broadcast_address`
  * `mtu`
  * `tftp_server`
  * `bootfile`
  * `ranges`
  * `deny_unknown_clients`
  * `default_lease_time`
  * `max_lease_time`
  * `options`

name.title: Subnet Name
name.description: Unique name; reservations reference it with `subnet`.

domain_name.title: Domain Name
domain_name.description: Overrides the global domain name for this subnet.

domain_name_servers.title: DNS Servers
domain_name_servers.description: Overrides the global DNS servers for this subnet.

ntp_servers.title: NTP Servers
ntp_servers.description: Overrides the global NTP servers for this subnet.

tftp_server.title: TFTP / POAP Server
tftp_server.description: TFTP server for POAP and PXE (next-server, options 66 and 150).

bootfile.title: Boot File
bootfile.description: Boot file name (option 67), for example the POAP script.

ranges.title: Address Pools
ranges.description: Dynamic pools. Leave empty to serve reservations only.

deny_unknown_clients.title: Deny Unknown Clients
deny_unknown_clients.description: The default value is `false`. When true, pools only serve clients that have a reservation.

default_lease_time.title: Default Lease Time
default_lease_time.description: Overrides the global default lease time (seconds).

max_lease_time.title: Maximum Lease Time
max_lease_time.description: Overrides the global maximum lease time (seconds).

options.title: Subnet Options
options.description: Extra Kea option-data entries for this subnet.

subnets.ranges.title: Address Pool
subnets.ranges.description:
A dynamic address range inside the subnet.

Required fields are:
  * `start`
  * `end`
